pods.name: Night Market Hall
pods.scene: Night Market Hall, a two-storey food hall with a mezzanine walkway across the middle: noodle and dumpling stalls with steam and paper lanterns, a skewer grill, a bubble tea counter, long shared tables full of people eating and laughing, a tiny arcade corner, hanging plants, string lights, crates of fruit, a cat asleep on a stool.

pods.name: Reactor Room
pods.scene: Reactor Room: a glowing blue fusion core in a cage of pipes, gauges and valves, one engineer in coveralls up a ladder tightening a pipe, another reading a clipboard at a console of chunky switches, a coffee mug, a tool chest, a few sparks, warning stripes, a little robot vacuum asleep in the corner.

pods.name: Hydro Garden
pods.scene: Hydro Garden: shelves of hydroponic lettuce, tomatoes and herbs under purple grow lights, water tanks with bubbling pipes, a gardener misting plants, a kid picking strawberries, a box fan, seed packets, watering cans, a frog in a terrarium.

pods.name: Pet Lounge
pods.scene: Pet Lounge: a small indoor dog park with fake grass, a fire hydrant and a ball pit, dogs of different breeds playing tug and sniffing around, a cat on a climbing tower, a person filling food bowls, a dog-wash tub, leashes on hooks, treat jars.

pods.name: Arcade Lounge
pods.scene: Arcade Lounge: a row of glowing retro arcade cabinets, friends on a couch playing a console game on a big old CRT TV, a claw machine, a pinball machine, neon tubes, beanbags, a snack shelf, cables everywhere.

pods.name: Bunk Quarters
pods.scene: Bunk Quarters: stacked sleeping capsules with curtains, each made personal with posters, fairy lights and plushies, someone reading in their bunk, someone climbing a ladder with a towel, a laundry basket, a sleepy cat, a small round window of stars.

pods.name: Ramen Counter
pods.scene: Ramen Counter: a narrow ramen bar with stools, a chef ladling broth behind steaming pots, customers slurping noodles, a short noren curtain, menu boards on wooden tags, a cat begging for scraps.

pods.name: Low-G Gym
pods.scene: Low-G Gym: weight racks, a treadmill facing a star window, someone spotting a friend on the bench press, a punching bag, a pull-up bar, chalk dust, water bottles, a motivational poster.

pods.name: Tiny Cinema
pods.scene: Tiny Cinema: a few rows of plush seats facing a glowing screen showing a space adventure, a projector beam through dust, a popcorn machine, people sharing snacks and laughing.

pods.name: Laundromat
pods.scene: Laundromat: a wall of round washing machines spinning, someone folding shirts, a basket of socks, a vending machine, a person asleep in a plastic chair, a dog waiting by a dryer.

pods.name: Record Shop
pods.scene: Record Shop and Listening Bar: crates of vinyl, a turntable with headphones, a listening booth, a DJ behind the counter, gig posters, a couple browsing records.

pods.name: Book Nook
pods.scene: Book Nook: floor-to-ceiling bookshelves with a rolling ladder, armchairs, reading lamps, someone asleep under an open book, a kid on a beanbag, a tea trolley.

pods.name: Repair Workshop
pods.scene: Repair Workshop: a workbench with a half-built robot, someone soldering, a pegboard of tools, bins of spare parts, a mechanic under a hover scooter, sparks, an old radio.

pods.name: Aquarium Room
pods.scene: Aquarium Room: big glowing fish tanks with tropical fish, a jellyfish column, a coral tank, someone cleaning a tank, kids pressed to the glass, bubbling filters.

pods.name: Bathhouse
pods.scene: Bathhouse: a steaming tiled hot-spring pool with people relaxing in it, towels on racks, wooden buckets, bamboo, a mural of mountains, a rubber duck.

pods.name: Observatory
pods.scene: Observatory: a big brass telescope pointed through a round viewport, star charts, an astronomer at a messy desk, a kid looking through the eyepiece, a model of the planet.

pods.name: Med Bay
pods.scene: Med Bay: a small clean clinic with a bed, a doctor checking a patient's pulse, a scanner arm, medicine cabinets, a potted plant, a sticker chart.

pods.name: Bakery
pods.scene: Bakery: glowing ovens, bread racks, a baker pulling out a tray of croissants, a short queue at the counter, a cake in a glass case, flour on the floor.

pods.name: Plant Nursery
pods.scene: Plant Nursery: hanging pots, succulents, bags of soil, someone repotting a big monstera, a watering hose, a shop cat curled up in an empty pot.

pods.name: Band Room
pods.scene: Band Room: a drummer, a guitarist and a keyboard player rehearsing, amps, foam on the walls, cables, a setlist taped to the wall, a friend filming on a phone.

pods.name: Tea House
pods.scene: Tea House: low tables and cushions, people pouring tea, a kettle on a little stove, shelves of tea tins, paper lanterns, a bonsai.

pods.name: Shuttle Garage
pods.scene: Shuttle Garage: a small shuttle with its hatch open, a mechanic on a creeper underneath it, fuel lines, a tool cart, a cat asleep on the wing.

pods.name: Cargo & Mail
pods.scene: Cargo and Mail Room: parcels on shelves, a conveyor belt, a postal worker sorting letters, a little drone forklift, a dog carrying a parcel in its mouth.
